description: E-invoicing obligations and deadlines for Germany (XRechnung, ZUGFeRD), Romania (e-Factura), Poland (KSeF), France (approved platforms) and Belgium (Peppol): whether, from when and how businesses must send or receive e-invoices in B2B. Returns the B2B scope, accepted formats (for example whether paper or PDF invoices are still allowed), the delivery channel and key dates, each with its official source and the date it was checked, plus a flag when re-verification is due. General, dated information, not legal or tax advice and not a case-by-case assessment. Other countries return "not covered".
